YOUR PEACE OF MIND

Privacy policy

A clear view of the information FirstLane uses, why it is needed, and the choices you have.

Last updated October 6, 2026 · FirstLane app & website
ON THIS PAGE1. Who is responsible2. Information FirstLane uses3. How and why we use it4. Service providers and sharing5. How long information is kept6. Your choices and requests7. International processing8. Keeping information secure9. Younger learners10. Changes and contact
Your practice is personal.

This website does not run advertising pixels or analytics trackers. We use information to provide FirstLane, protect accounts, recognise purchases and respond when you ask for help. Account deletion is available here.

1. Who is responsible

FirstLane is a product of Tervlon Labs (“FirstLane”, “we”, “us”). This policy covers the FirstLane mobile app and this website.

The seller shown on your App Store or Google Play listing may be a separate authorised publisher. The store listing and your receipt identify the seller responsible for that store transaction. Our role is to develop and operate FirstLane and support your use of the product.

Privacy questions and requests: Contact our privacy team.

2. Information FirstLane uses

InformationPurpose
Account and identityYour email address, account ID, optional display name, preferences and authentication records are used to create, secure and maintain your account. Supabase handles authentication.
Study activityPractice answers, session history, bookmarks, review lists and selected topics are used to provide study features. Some study data stays on your device; synced progress is stored against your account when you use the sync feature.
Purchases and accessStore transaction identifiers, product and entitlement identifiers, purchase or refund status and related account references are used to recognise and restore valid purchases. Apple or Google processes payment; FirstLane does not receive your full payment-card details.
Support and content reportsYour contact email, the information in your message, question references and relevant troubleshooting details allow us to respond and investigate. Please do not send passwords, card numbers or verification codes in support messages.
Security and deliveryWeb servers and service providers process technical information such as IP address, request time and browser/device information to deliver the service, limit abuse and investigate failures.
Website preferencesA local preference records whether you have paused website animations. This is not an advertising identifier. Account-deletion verification codes and access tokens are held only temporarily during the web flow, not stored in browser local storage.

3. How and why we use it

We use the information described above to provide the account and learning features you request, send account verification or recovery messages, deliver content you have purchased, maintain progress, provide support and protect FirstLane against misuse. We also use limited records when necessary to handle disputes or comply with applicable obligations.

We do not use your study answers to make credit, employment or insurance decisions. We do not sell your personal information. This website does not run behavioural advertising or cross-site tracking.

Where your consent is required for a particular activity, we request it separately. Sending a support or deletion request does not sign you up for marketing. Withdrawing optional consent does not affect processing already carried out lawfully or processing needed to fulfil your request.

4. Service providers and sharing

Provider or recipientRole
SupabaseAccount authentication, database, server functions and content storage. It processes account details and related application records needed to provide these services.
RevenueCatPurchase and entitlement management. It processes app-user and store-purchase references used to check paid access.
Apple / GoogleApp distribution, store checkout, transaction handling and refunds under their own terms and privacy policies.
Website hosting providerDelivers website files and server functions and processes technical request information.
Authentication email providerDelivers verification and account-recovery messages.
ResendDelivers messages from the website contact form to our support mailbox. The email address and message you submit are included.
Cloudflare TurnstileProvides abuse prevention on the support and account-deletion forms. It processes technical signals to help distinguish legitimate requests from automated abuse.

We may share limited information with an authorised app publisher for purchase support, with professional advisers where necessary, or when disclosure is required by law. A business transfer involving FirstLane may require transfer of relevant records with appropriate protections and notice where required.

5. How long information is kept

RecordRetention and deletion
Account and synced study recordsRetained while your account is active. Following a verified deletion, active account and associated profile, synced practice and account-linked report records are removed as the deletion is processed.
BackupsRestricted backups follow a limited rotation period. Deleted account information is not used to reactivate your account. Contact the privacy team for information about a backup affecting your request.
Security logsTechnical logs are retained only as needed to protect the service, investigate identified incidents or meet applicable obligations.
Support correspondenceSupport correspondence is kept for the time needed to resolve your request and handle related follow-up or disputes.
Transaction and audit recordsLimited transaction-event, refund and audit information may need to be retained for accounting, fraud prevention, dispute handling or legal obligations. We explain any relevant exception when responding to your request.
Records held by processorsWe coordinate account-data removal with processors acting on our behalf, subject to applicable retention obligations. Apple and Google retain their own store and purchase records under their policies.

We limit retained information to what is necessary for the stated purpose. Records no longer needed are deleted or appropriately anonymised. A legal hold can require an otherwise scheduled deletion to be deferred; we explain this where legally permitted.

6. Your choices and requests

You can update available account details and preferences in the app. You can ask us about access to your information, correction, deletion, a copy of your data, or objections to processing where applicable. We may need to verify that the account belongs to you before disclosing or changing personal information.

Use Contact our privacy team for a privacy request. We respond within the period applicable to your request and location and explain any lawful refusal or extension. You can raise an unresolved privacy concern with the relevant privacy regulator, including the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada where applicable.

To remove an account, use Profile → Your account → Delete account in FirstLane, or use the web account-deletion flow. You do not need to reinstall the app to start from the website.

Deleting the account removes access to that account and its synced study history. It does not request an Apple or Google refund, and may prevent purchase restoration to that deleted FirstLane account. Local copies on an offline device are not remotely erased by this website; remove the app’s local data on devices you control.

7. International processing

FirstLane and its service providers may process information outside your province or country. The location depends on the hosting and service-provider systems involved. Information may be subject to laws and lawful access requests in those locations.

We remain responsible for selecting and overseeing providers that process information on our behalf and use contractual and operational safeguards appropriate to the information. Contact us for details relevant to your information or request.

8. Keeping information secure

We use encrypted transport, authenticated account actions and access controls intended to protect information. The website does not contain privileged database credentials. Deletion requires verification and an explicit confirmation. No service can guarantee perfect security.

Keep your email account and device secure. Enter a verification code only into a FirstLane sign-in or deletion screen you opened yourself. Our support team will not ask you to send them a password or code.

9. Younger learners

FirstLane is intended for learners aged 16 or older. Where you are below the age at which you can independently accept the applicable terms, a parent or guardian should review the service with you. We do not intend to collect account information from children below our stated minimum age. Contact us if you believe such information was provided so we can review and remove it as appropriate.

10. Changes and contact

We update this policy when the service or its data practices change. The date at the top identifies the current version. Where a change requires additional notice or consent, we provide it before applying the relevant change.

Privacy contact: Contact our privacy team.
Product operator: Tervlon Labs.
